explanation: Put every pen and every role=moved item (covering the second pen mislabelled as a box cutter) into the white tub, skipping any already inside.
author: wonder
diff_from_parent:
--- v0.py
+++ v1.py
@@ -0,0 +1,14 @@
+def run(scene, robot):
+    tub = scene.get("white tub")
+    targets = []
+    for obj in scene.of_kind("pen") + scene.with_role("moved"):
+        if obj.name not in targets:
+            targets.append(obj.name)
+    log("targets: " + str(targets))
+    for name in targets:
+        cur = scene.get(name)
+        dst = scene.get(tub.name)
+        if scene.is_inside(cur, dst):
+            continue
+        robot.pick(cur)
+        robot.place_in(scene.get(tub.name))
